briefs.label: APEC
briefs.text: APEC adopts the Shenzhen Outlook — digital-risk cooperation pledged; Xi gives $20m.

briefs.label: UK · AI
briefs.text: MPs: close AI safety gaps to secure a £400bn growth prize, Parliament warns.

briefs.label: MOROCCO
briefs.text: Defence roadmap unveiled: 50,000 jobs and 65% export revenue by 2035.

briefs.label: BENIN
briefs.text: Seeks return of 35 looted artworks from France, including a 1.65m god Gou statue.

briefs.label: SCIENCE
briefs.text: mRNA vaccine design shows broad protection against Nipah and Hendra viruses.

briefs.label: SPORT
briefs.text: NBA: Hawks stun Thunder 117–112; Jazz beat Lakers 109–97; Bulls rout Nets 137–107.

briefs.label: SPACE
briefs.text: NASA JPL hosts a live Voyager discussion at 17:00 UTC.

briefs.label: JAKARTA
briefs.text: Estonian tech and maritime firms in town for digital and smart-port talks.

briefs.label: INDONESIA
briefs.text: BMKG puts West Kalimantan on top rain alert; 16 provinces on alert for heavy rain.

briefs.label: USA
briefs.text: Atmospheric river swings south: LA on flash-flood watch, Sierra braces for 4 ft of snow.

briefs.label: UK · MEDIA
briefs.text: Government asks YouTube to remove Brand's prison video; Google refuses.

briefs.label: KOREA
briefs.text: Top court orders retrial for ex-PM Han — 15-year martial-law sentence overturned.

briefs.label: SOMALIA
briefs.text: Expels UAE ambassador — 72 hours to leave; envoy recalled over 'open invasion'.

briefs.label: RIYADH
briefs.text: Houthi missiles intercepted over Riyadh — debris damages a financial-district tower.

briefs.label: COLOMBIA
briefs.text: National strike — unions and teachers march in five cities against the rescue bill.

briefs.label: AUSTRALIA
briefs.text: Jobless hits 4.9% — five-year high as 43,500 jobs vanish; rate-cut bets grow.

briefs.label: KOREA
briefs.text: Suneung: 551,864 sit the exam — flights grounded in an AI-cheating crackdown.

briefs.label: SPORT
briefs.text: Marathon champion banned 3 years — Jepchirchir admits EPO, loses Sydney title.

briefs.label: FLORIDA
briefs.text: Floods shut schools a second day — five counties closed as rain keeps falling.

cards.body: Opened at $111.50, +34% on its $83 IPO price, briefly topping $2tn. The $81.3bn sale is the largest IPO ever.
cards.headline: Anthropic opens at $111.50

cards.body: Bears down on Odisha and Andhra Pradesh; landfall Friday noon. Winds 90–100 km/h; red alert in 10 districts.
cards.headline: 47,000 flee Cyclone Akvan

cards.body: Ministers haggle in Antalya over the draft deal — fossil-fuel phaseout, adaptation finance — before Friday's close.
cards.headline: COP31 enters final 48 hours

cards.body: Russia struck the capital in the early hours; four wounded in the region, energy grid hit in Odesa.
cards.headline: Drones strike Kyiv overnight

cards.body: Foreign and defence ministers meet in Tokyo — defence co-development, maritime security, joint exercises.
cards.headline: India and Japan hold 2+2 talks

cards.body: Final report: her wind vulnerability was never assessed. 80mph gusts capsized her in 15 seconds.
cards.headline: Bayesian crew 'unaware of risk'

cards.body: Ministers meet at Iveagh House on Troubles legacy law and Northern Ireland's budget.
cards.headline: UK and Irish ministers meet

cards.body: Young Britons could work and study in the EU by 2028 under a draft deal, ahead of Friday's UK–EU summit.
cards.headline: Under-30s set for EU visas

cards.body: Ground rents capped at £250 a year from 2028; commonhold becomes the default for new flats. ~5m homes affected.
cards.headline: Leasehold Bill enters Parliament

cards.body: Third strike in four days: Neptune missiles hit the railway section overnight, halting trains to Crimea.
cards.headline: Kerch rail bridge hit again

cards.body: Parliament unanimously approves the US–Greenland security deal: more US bases, missile defence, sovereignty kept.
cards.headline: Denmark votes 109–0 for Arctic pact

cards.body: After 18 years, parliament lets the state seize corruption-linked assets over Rp1bn without a conviction first.
cards.headline: Indonesia passes asset-seizure law

Hemedti death sentence in Port Sudan

heroes.body: First-ever trilateral, 90 minutes at Kylin Villa. A four-point 'Declaration toward Peace': UN reform, oil, nuclear talks, ICC limits. No word on Ukraine.
heroes.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin issue declaration

heroes.body: Midnight launch, New Zealand first. Metacritic 99 from 150+ reviews, tied best ever. 15.9m pre-orders, $1.54bn. $79.99, PS5/Xbox, no PC.
heroes.headline: GTA VI is out today

heroes.body: 9–6: Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya, the first such verdict against a state. Reparations ordered; 730,000+ fled in 2017.
heroes.headline: ICJ: Myanmar guilty of genocide
